title: 第 86章 路过山野第85 章 抱雪真人
slug: 杀妖涨修为道爷我成了
lines: 沈回整了整衣襟，将三个葫芦用外袍稍稍遮了一遮。
抬头望了望天色。
月已西沉，东方天际隐隐泛起一抹淡白。
将所有东西收拾停当，他分辨了一下方向，寻到北辰所在。
“走了。”
陆欢把最后一口鸡腿肉塞进嘴里，拍了拍手，跑到他身边。
她低头看了看他腰间的葫芦，伸出手指戳了戳那只九窍阴葫，小声喊了一句：
“抱雪师祖，你在吗？”
葫芦壁上的一个孔窍里伸出一根极小的手臂，在她指尖上轻轻拍了一下，又缩了回去。
陆欢咯咯笑了两声，满意地抓住沈回衣摆。
沈回祭出白骸，剑身横在身前，寒光流转。
随后他指诀一掐，剑光乍起，裹挟着两人破空而去。
此次御剑，与往常大不相同。
他在催动剑光之时，试着将一缕五行神光融入其中。
剑光本是清冷的森白，此时却隐隐泛起一层彩芒。
那彩芒覆在剑光表面，若不细看，几乎察觉不到。
可就是这薄薄的一层彩芒，却让剑光的速度暴增不知几许。
耳边风声呼啸如雷，只剩一片模糊的青灰从视野两侧飞速掠过。
沈回心中暗暗吃了一惊。
这速度比之前快了何止一倍？
而且剑光凝练稳定，破空之时几乎感受不到阻力，仿佛前方的空气都被那层彩芒尽数消融。
只不过，快的确是快，可灵气消耗也随之陡增。
他略一估算，若以这般速度全力飞遁，不出两炷香的功夫，丹田气海便要见底。
所以为了稳妥起见，他每飞一阵便要按下剑光，落回地面走上一段。
如此走走停停，虽然慢了些，却能始终保持灵力充沛，若遇上什么突发状况也能及时应对。
天渐渐亮了。
晨曦从山脊后透出，先是染红了天边的一线云霞，然后给群峰镀上一层淡金。
山间的雾气被阳光一照，蒸腾起层层白烟，林子里鸟鸣声此起彼伏，清脆悦耳。
沈回落地步行的时候也不闲着。
他的目光在路边的草木间逡巡，看到有野果树便凑过去摘几个。
这个时节山间的野果大半尚未成熟，青涩得很，咬一口酸得人直皱眉。
他却吃得津津有味，一个接一个地往嘴里丢，面不改色。
陆欢见他吃得香，也摘了一个野果，一口咬下去，酸得整张脸都皱成了包子褶。
她把剩下的大半个野果往沈回手里一塞，说什么也不肯再吃。
沈回也不勉强，将那几个野果擦了擦，挑出一个模样周正的，装进九窍阴葫。
葫芦里传来抱雪真人一声含糊的念叨，随即又归于沉寂。
这一路上，沈回但凡看到巨大的古树或是粗壮的树洞，都要走过去仔细打量一番。
有时还会伸手在树干上敲一敲，听听声音是否中空。
看到瀑布水帘，就掐一个避水诀将水流截断，看看后面有没有隐藏的洞府。
看到崖壁上有裂隙，便凑近了探头张望，确认里头有没有什么灵气波动。
陆欢跟在旁边，有样学样，也开始四处乱看。
她看到一棵老树的树根底下有个黑黝黝的洞，凑过去看了一眼，随后立刻便紧张兮兮地跑过来扯沈回的袖子：
“那边那边，有个洞，里面有东西！”
沈回闻言走过去看了看，结果发现是个兔子窝。
里面一窝灰兔挤在一处，瞪着眼睛瑟瑟发抖。
content_en:
Shen Hui straightened his clothes and slightly covered the three gourds with his outer robe.
He looked up at the sky.
The moon has set in the west, and there is a faint whiteness in the eastern sky.
After packing everything up, he looked at the direction and found Beichen's location.
"Gone."
Lu Huan stuffed the last bite of chicken drumstick into his mouth, clapped his hands and ran to him.
She looked down at the gourd on his waist, stretched out her finger to poke the nine-aperture yin gourd, and whispered:
"Master Baoxue, are you there?"
A tiny arm stretched out from a hole in the gourd wall, tapped her fingertips, and then retracted.
Lu Huan chuckled twice and grabbed Shen Hui's clothes with satisfaction.
Shen Hui sacrificed the white corpse, the sword was lying in front of him, and the cold light was flowing.
Then he pinched his fingers, and the sword light suddenly appeared, carrying the two of them and flying through the air.
This time with the sword, it was very different from usual.
When he activated the sword light, he tried to incorporate a ray of divine light from the Five Elements into it.
The sword light was originally a cold white color, but now it had a faint glow.
The colorful light covers the surface of the sword light, and is almost imperceptible if you don't look closely.
But just this thin layer of colorful light caused the speed of the sword light to increase dramatically.
The wind howled like thunder in his ears, and only a blur of gray gray flew past both sides of his field of vision.
Shen Hui was secretly surprised.
Is this speed more than twice as fast as before?
Moreover, the sword light is condensed and stable, and there is almost no resistance when it breaks through the air, as if the air in front of it is completely melted by the layer of colorful light.
However, it is indeed fast, but the consumption of spiritual energy also increases sharply.
He made a rough estimate, and if he flew away with all his strength at such a speed, it would take less than two sticks of incense to reach the bottom of the sea of ​​qi in his dantian.
So for the sake of safety, he had to press the sword light every time he flew for a while, fall back to the ground and walk for a while.
By walking in this way, although it is a bit slow, you can always keep your spiritual energy full, and you can respond in time if you encounter any emergencies.
It's getting daylight.
The morning sun shines from behind the ridge, first dyeing the ray of clouds on the horizon red, and then plating the peaks with a layer of light gold.
The fog in the mountains is illuminated by the sun, and layers of white smoke evaporate. The birdsong in the forest comes and goes, crisp and sweet.
Shen Hui was not idle even when he was walking.
His eyes wandered among the grass and trees on the roadside. When he saw a wild fruit tree, he went over to pick a few.
At this time of the year, most of the wild fruits in the mountains are not yet ripe, and are very green and astringent. One bite of them is so sour that it makes people frown.
But he ate with gusto, throwing each piece into his mouth without changing his expression.
Lu Huan saw that he was eating well, so he also picked a wild fruit and bit into it. His whole face was so sour that it wrinkled into a bun.
She stuffed most of the remaining wild fruit back into her hands and refused to eat any more.
Shen Hui didn't force himself, he wiped the wild fruits, picked out an upright one, and put it into the Nine-Aperture Yin Gourd.
From the gourd, Master Baoxue muttered vaguely, and then fell silent again.
Along the way, whenever Shen Hui saw a huge old tree or a thick tree hole, he would walk over and take a closer look.
Sometimes I will reach out and knock on the trunk of the tree to hear whether the sound is hollow.
When you see the water curtain of the waterfall, you do a water avoidance trick to cut off the flow of water and see if there is a hidden cave behind it.
Seeing a crack on the cliff, he moved closer and looked around to see if there were any spiritual energy fluctuations inside.
Lu Huan followed, imitating others, and started looking around.
She saw a dark hole under the roots of an old tree. She went over to take a look, and then immediately ran over nervously and pulled Shen Hui's sleeves:
"Over there, there's a hole, and there's something in it!"
When Shen Hui heard this, he walked over and took a look, only to find that it was a rabbit nest.
Inside, a nest of gray rabbits huddled together, staring and trembling.
